fact: The "Line height" control in the text properties panel applies to the whole text element and offers presets "Tight" = 1.0, "Normal" = 1.25 and "Loose" = 1.5, plus a number field that accepts a typed value from 0.8 to 2.5 in steps of 0.05.
source: PO answer on issue 99002, approved 2026-10-13 by maxxx [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T12:53:50.612Z, fingerprint f9cb73c20c43; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: In the "Line height" field, values below 0.8 become 0.8, values above 2.5 become 2.5, values between steps round to the nearest 0.05, a comma decimal such as "1,5" is read as 1.5, and empty or non-numeric input keeps the previous value.
source: PO answer 3 on issue 99002, approved 2026-10-13 by maxxx [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T12:53:50.612Z, fingerprint f9cb73c20c43; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: New text keeps its font's own line height until a line height is chosen, after which the last chosen value is the default; a text whose line height was set keeps it when its font family changes, while a never-set text follows the new font's line height.
source: PO answer 2 on issue 99002, approved 2026-10-13 by maxxx [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T12:53:50.612Z, fingerprint f9cb73c20c43; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: The "Line height" control is shown when a text, a shape with text, an arrow with a label or a sticky note is selected or the Text tool is active, not for shapes without text, images or an empty selection; with several texts at different line heights no preset is highlighted and one choice sets all of them.
source: Approved answers 4 and 7 in the issue 99002 session, 2026-10-13 [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T12:53:50.612Z, fingerprint f9cb73c20c43; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: A larger line height makes a shape holding text grow taller with the same width and a smaller one lets it shrink back; an arrow label stays at the middle of the arrow; a sticky note's auto-fit takes line height into account and never shows the label larger than the picked font size.
source: Approved answers 5 and 6 in the issue 99002 session, 2026-10-13 [answers approved by maxxx at 2026-10-13T12:53:50.612Z, fingerprint f9cb73c20c43; change set changes/excalidraw-99002.md]

fact: Line height survives a page reload, a saved .excalidraw file, PNG and SVG export and live collaboration; paste styles, copies and library items carry it and undo/redo restore it; older Excalidraw versions are out of scope.
